scientific_question: Do the pre-frozen VEO-IBD directions of three AD-skin--VEO-IBD mass hypotheses replicate at the IBD end in PRISM and Netherlands?

leakage_status.target_masses: fixed to 295.2266, 197.1285, and 158.1176 before ST001000 effects
leakage_status.expected_directions: read from the VEO-IBD right_beta in the frozen ledger before ST001000 abundance or phenotype effects
leakage_status.feature_selection: nearest positive-mode feature within 10 ppm, selected without phenotype

claim_boundary.supported_scope: independent participant replication test of the IBD end
claim_boundary.identity_limitation: ST001000 abundance matrices are full-scan and lack sample-linked MS/MS; mass matching is not identity confirmation

source_provenance.cohort_independence: PRISM and Netherlands contain independent participants but belong to one published study package; they are not two independent projects

preprocessing_and_models.abundance: within-sample sum normalization to 1e6, half-minimum zero smoothing, log10
preprocessing_and_models.PRISM_primary: CD and UC vs control with age, antibiotics, immunosuppressants, mesalamine, and steroids; medication complete cases
preprocessing_and_models.PRISM_sensitivity: same model with medication NA treated as no
preprocessing_and_models.Netherlands: CD and UC vs control with age
preprocessing_and_models.multiplicity: BH within each cohort/model across all mass-matched target-mode x CD/UC tests

result_interpretation: A three-fit concordance pass requires the frozen VEO direction and within-fit BH q<=0.05 for the same diagnosis in PRISM primary, Netherlands, and PRISM sensitivity. This is not formal replicated-findings FDR control, and PRISM sensitivity is not an independent cohort.
ols_inference_boundary: Classical homoskedastic OLS standard errors reproduce the intended published model; heteroskedasticity-robust and outlier sensitivity were not tested.
